title: ever RYLEE|See-Through Long Sleeve V-Neck High Slit Chiffon Formal Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
This See-Through Long Sleeve V-Neck High Slit Chiffon Formal Evening Dress is a captivating blend of elegance and allure. The delicate chiffon fabric flows beautifully, while the high slit adds a touch of drama. The see-through long sleeves and plunging V-neck create a sophisticated silhouette, perfect for formal events, galas, or evening celebrations. Make a striking impression with this timeless yet modern design.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
